name: Destroyman III, Bon Vivant Adventurer
desc: Destroyman III, Bon Vivant Adventurer is a "mischievous wayward traveller" based on [Destroyman III](entity:destroyman_iii_bon_vivant_adventurer).
additional_info: -   When the player is near Destroyman III, Bon Vivant Adventurer, a sea shanty is played. That same sea shanty can be heard at [The Three Cheers](location:the_three_cheers) tavern in [Fort Merit](location:fort_merit).
